title: Dunning and Collections Automation for Scalable Subscription Businesses
summary: Key Takeaways Failed payments drive 20%–40% of subscription churn, per Stripe. That makes dunning one of the cheapest revenue levers you have. Recovery speed comes down to one number: average days to cash after a missed payment. Mid-range speed with high customer-impact tends to beat pure speed. Rule-based dunning engines go live in a day, but expect to tune them weekly to keep collection rates from drifting. AI-driven platforms need a two-week pilot to train the model. After that, monthly upkeep drops below two hours. ERP-integrated suites take multi-week rollouts and usually a dedicated analyst, but they match cash better and need far fewer manual tweaks.
